criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (Champion carry-forward consistency), Criterion 4 (Champion next steps specificity), Criterion 1 (Economic Buyer evidence quality)
suggested_change: Criterion 2 should explicitly require: 'If prior score is downgraded, state whether this is a correction due to new contradicting evidence or a reinterpretation of the rubric. Reinterpretations must be flagged as rubric clarifications, not carry-forward logic.' Criterion 4 should include template language: 'Next steps must name a contact (or state '[TBD]'), specify the deliverable, and set a concrete date.' Criterion 1 should state: 'A 3/10 requires at least one paraphrase or direct quote from call transcripts indicating budget authority exists; vague references to 'executive sign-off' score 1/10.'
